title.en: Your attention span is not fixed

en: Attention span is not a fixed trait — it shifts with task, energy, and setting. Measure it on a task you dread, not one you like.
The distractibility delay: work in chunks that match your real span, then deliberately delay the distraction. The break is planned and short — it is part of the method, not an escape from it.
When the urge to switch comes, note it and give yourself a set minute before you act on it. Most urges pass if you let them.
Pick one dreaded task. Work on it and track how long you stayed focused and how many times you were pulled away.
Run three chunked work sessions this week using the delay technique.
What is likely to get in the way this week, and what will you do when it happens?
